name: veil-sdk
description: Veil privacy-pool SDK: client-side note discovery + ERC-3643 balances (STRK20 §5.4; the viewing key never leaves the device) plus a SNIP-36 prover client (VeilProver) to execute pool functions via derive -> prove -> settle.
_comment: Vendored build of the Veil SDK, as veilx does it. The app is a standalone repository, so it carries the compiled SDK rather than reaching outside itself for it.
